questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of learning to use public transit before arriving in Canada?

options.text: It guarantees you’ll never get lost in a new city
It reduces stress and saves time when navigating to school or errands
It ensures you won’t need to ask for help from locals
It allows you to avoid using transit apps or mapsCorrect Answer: b)

questions.question_text: Why is setting up a Canadian bank account important for international students?

options.text: It allows you to avoid paying any fees for transactions
It simplifies payments, avoids high international fees, and helps manage daily expenses
It guarantees immediate access to a credit card without any checks
It is only necessary if you plan to work in CanadaCorrect Answer: b)

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of a land acknowledgement for international students in Canada?

options.text: To fulfill a mandatory university assignment without personal reflection
To show respect for Indigenous Peoples and recognize their traditional territories
To focus solely on Canadian history without connecting to current contexts
To replace learning about local customs with a written statementCorrect Answer: b)

questions.question_text: How does volunteering benefit international students integrating into Canadian life?

options.text: It ensures students avoid interacting with local communities to focus on studies
It builds skills, fosters connections, and aligns with Canadian values of giving back
It is only useful for students who want to work in non-profit organizations
It prevents students from needing to participate in campus activitiesCorrect Answer: b)

questions.question_text: What is one purpose of creating a cultural immersion documentation portfolio?

options.text: To track and reflect on personal growth and cultural experiences in Canada
To submit as a formal academic requirement for all courses
To focus only on challenges without celebrating achievements
To avoid sharing experiences with family or friends back homeCorrect Answer: a)

questions.question_text: Why is it important to regularly measure and adjust your integration progress in Canada?

options.text: To compare your success with other students and compete for recognition
To recognize achievements, identify challenges, and adapt strategies for better integration
To focus only on failures without celebrating small wins
To avoid seeking support from mentors or university resourcesCorrect Answer: b)
